gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient with a localized disease for which no curative therapy is available and a measurable lesion is still amenable for RECIST assessment after biopsy (to manufacture the vaccine) are allowed (example: GBM or sarcoma with local relapse after surgery, chemo-radiation)

candidate_evidence.quote: MVX-ONCO-2 is a patient-specific, cell-based, active immunotherapy where the participant's immune response to their own tumor cells is stimulated and/or increased.
A full treatment course with MVX-ONCO-2 consists of a total of 6 vaccinations: 4 vaccinations 1 week apart, followed by 2 boosters 2 weeks apart.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient with advanced metastatic solid tumors with documented tumor progression after at least one line of systemic therapy and for which no further standard therapies are available, feasible or accepted by the patient.

role_evidence.quote: MVX-ONCO-2 is composed of a cell suspension of irradiated autologous tumor cells and two capsules loaded with allogenic genetically modified cells releasing an immunomodulator, granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor (GM-CSF).

agents.drug_class_hint: personalised cell-based cancer vaccine: irradiated autologous tumour cells plus encapsulated allogeneic GM-CSF-secreting genetically modified cells (MVX-ONCO-2)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: the participant's immune response to their own tumor cells is stimulated and/or increased

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; GBM named in the inclusion criteria as an example of eligible localized relapsed disease, so basket_gbm_eligible (D27B). Sole intervention is a cell-based cancer vaccine (excluded type). GM-CSF is released by encapsulated cells within the product, not given as a separate drug; not listed separately.
